rows.why: The supplied AACT outcomes do not report death from any cause. Cardiovascular death within composite endpoints does not match this outcome. No open full text, regulatory evidence, or meta rows were supplied.
All ertugliflozin versus placebo, all randomized participants, on-study follow-up. The reported estimand is HR, whereas the protocol requests RR; no whole-number event counts or RR are provided.

AACT provides no whole-number event counts or denominators. Its MACE effect is HR rather than protocol RR, with a 95.02% CI rather than the required 95% CI. Whole-randomised-population coverage cannot be verified. No open full text, regulatory evidence or meta rows were supplied.

Combined canagliflozin doses versus placebo; two-sided 95% CI. Reported estimand is HR, not the requested RR. AACT states all randomized participants were included; denominators and open full text are unavailable for independent population verification.

AACT reports an HR rather than the requested RR, but does not establish that its 95% CI is two-sided. No event counts or denominators establish a whole-randomised-population result. No open full text or other primary source is supplied.

No eligible MACE result: AACT provides no whole-number event counts or denominators; primary HR intervals are 95.6%, not 95%, and HR differs from requested RR. The treated population is not confirmed to cover everyone randomized. MACE Plus and recurrent MACE use different outcomes or estimands. No open full text, regulatory evidence, or meta rows supplied.
AACT reports cardiovascular death only within composite outcomes; no separate cardiovascular-death counts or effect are supplied. No open full text, regulatory excerpt, or meta row is provided.

AACT reports cardiovascular death only within the MACE composite; no separate cardiovascular-death counts or effect are supplied. Full text is withheld, and no regulatory windows or meta rows are provided.
AACT reports composites containing cardiovascular death and all-cause mortality, but no standalone cardiovascular death result. No open full text, regulatory evidence, or meta rows were supplied.

AACT provides no whole-number event counts or denominators. Its cardiovascular-death effects are HRs, not the requested RR, with 95.8% CIs rather than eligible 95% CIs. No open full text, regulatory result, or meta row is supplied.
